advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test asserting that with `ignore_untracked=True`, a TRACKED dirty state (modified/staged tracked file) and an unmerged (`ls-files -u`) entry still raise `store-read-failure`.
evidence: Both new tests write only UNTRACKED files: `(tracker / "6673-7636-a116-4f90-x-REVIEW_RESULT.json").write_text("{}", ...)` and assert `"store-read-failure" not in snapshot_reasons(...)` — positive path only.
Change docstring/commit invariant: `tracker_head_sha(tracker, ignore_untracked=True)` comment states "Tracked dirty state (modified/staged/unmerged) still fails, as it must."

relation_snapshot.py:133-144 shows the new mode keeps a `status --porcelain --untracked-files=no` check and a separate `ls-files -u` unmerged check — both are the behaviors that must still fail, and neither is exercised under `ignore_untracked=True`.

The existing `test_tracker_head_sha_requires_clean_valid_git_head` (tests/unit/test_plan_relation_snapshot.py:259) writes an UNTRACKED `dirty.txt` and calls `tracker_head_sha(str(tracker))` with default `ignore_untracked=False` — it does not cover the new mode, and it does not exercise a MODIFIED tracked file or an unmerged entry.
advisory.finding: The new `ignore_untracked=True` mode is only tested on the positive path (untracked files tolerated); no test asserts the change's stated invariant that TRACKED dirty state (modified/staged tracked file, or unmerged `ls-files -u` entry) STILL collapses to `store-read-failure` under `ignore_untracked=True`. A regression that broadened the new mode to also tolerate tracked dirty/unmerged state would pass every test.
scenarios: A future refactor of the status-arg selection in `tracker_head_sha` accidentally suppresses tracked-dirty detection under `ignore_untracked=True`.
The `ls-files -u` unmerged guard is dropped or bypassed in the ignore_untracked branch.
advisory.suggested_fix: Extend the suite with a case that commits a tracker file, then MODIFIES it (tracked dirty) and calls `tracker_head_sha(tracker, ignore_untracked=True)` / `collect_plan_relation_snapshot(..., ignore_untracked=True)` asserting `reason == "store-read-failure"`; add a parallel case for an unmerged index entry to cover the `ls-files -u` guard.

coaching.coaching: Add a regression test covering tracked dirty state still failing under ignore_untracked.
